projectTitle: Multi-Agent Results Gallery of Breaking Bad S1E1

scenes.title: Scene 001: Desert Landscape
scenes.prompt: Slow pan across the desert landscape with subtle heat shimmer and light wind moving sparse shrubs. Keep realism, no people.

scenes.title: Scene 002: RV Speeds Past
scenes.prompt: RV speeds past, kicking up dust; briefly runs over/brushes past the pants. Slight handheld shake, realistic suspension bounce, maintain the same RV design.

scenes.title: Scene 003: Driver Panics
scenes.prompt: Inside the RV, the driver panics while driving; heavy breathing behind the mask, hands tight on the wheel, vehicle vibration. Keep the same face and outfit throughout, no face morphing.

scenes.title: Scene 004: Chaotic RV
scenes.prompt: The RV swerves; objects and cash slide, liquid sloshes. Avoid explicit drugs/graphic bodies; show only generic clutter. Emphasize motion and chaos.

scenes.title: Scene 005: RV Rough Stop
scenes.prompt: RV loses control slightly and comes to a rough stop near a ditch. Big dust plume, then settling silence. Camera handheld but readable.

scenes.title: Scene 006: Exit the RV
scenes.prompt: Using the reference image as the first frame, generate an 8-second shot: the man steps out, stumbles one step, yanks off the gas mask, and gasps. Dust floats and settles. Keep framing and lighting consistent with the first frame; maintain identity and outfit.
